en.content:
A piston filled with 0.04 mol of an ideal gas expands reversibly from 50.0 mL to 375 mL at a constant temperature of 37.0oC. As it does so, it absorbs 208J of heat. The values of q and w for the process will be :
(R = 8.314 J/mol K) ( l n 7.5 = 2.01)
en.explanation:
By Ist law of thermodynamics, q = E – W

At const T, ∆E = 0

q = – W

Heat absorbed = 208 J

q = +208 J

W = – 208 J

An unknown alcohol is treated with the “Lucas reagent” to determine whether the alcohol is primary,
secondary or tertiary. Which alcohol reacts fastest and by what mechanism:
en.explanation: Tertiary alcohols reacts fastest with lucas reagnet as the rate of reaction is directly proportional to the stability of carbocation formed in the reaction. Since most stable carbocation is formed in the reaction hence it will react fastest further tetriary alcohols appears to react by mechanism.
